description: Product-level fragrance name candidates collected from public retailer and collection indexes for requested brands. This is a research overlay, not retailer offer data and not yet imported into the canonical database. Names are retained once per brand/name pair; variants, GTINs, prices, availability, and shipping are never inferred.

sources.name: Maison Asrar complete perfume index (independent guide)
sources.supports: 116 named fragrances; explicitly says independent, non-official guide; source page records sizes and notes where published.

sources.name: Maison Asrar official Royal Collection
sources.supports: Royal Collection listing; nine entries including Belgravia, Legacy, Vanguard, Regent, Majesty, Heritage, Monarch, Treasure and Imperial.

sources.name: Shop Aromatix - Signature Aromatix Collection
sources.supports: Ten Aromatix X French Avenue fragrance names; EDP 100 ml stated for the listed bottles.

sources.name: Jo Milano Paris - Game of Spades Coffret Set II
sources.supports: Official product page names nine Game of Spades fragrances in a 9 x 10 ml coffret; it is not evidence of 100 ml variants.

sources.name: Azmara all products
sources.supports: Retailer listing with brand facets and named products; used for selected examples.

sources.name: Essência Árabe full bottles collection
sources.supports: Retailer product list with brand and named fragrance listings.
